items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: The interviewee states his full name is Evans and explains how he got the nickname 'Buddy'. The name 'Evans' refers to the interviewee himself, not a separate person he has a relationship with.

ctx.x: Okay, Buddy Burton's my name. I have recorded so on and so on. Now, cut. I'm very proud to tell you that my name is Buddy Burton, and that's my professional name when I first started recording records. And so I've been using that away from that clean up until now. What is your full name? And my full name is Evans, my first name. But after I got into the recording game and come as a fool with music, well, my recording manager made the suggestion at our first recording. He said, that name is a little bit too long.…
Oh, yes. Mayor Williams. Mayor Williams.
